suggested_requirements.text: The RLCS application shall open and close the reversible lanes for morning and evening peak traffic hours and special events.
The RLCS application shall interface with field hardware components via driver software.
The RLCS application shall provide data to external systems via an external server data store.
The RLCS application shall allow remote access through a firewall by authorized users.
The RLCS application shall provide a graphical user interface for operators to view status, issue commands, configure the system, and generate reports.
The RLCS application shall perform a one-way data transfer of system status to an external computer every 30 seconds.
The RLCS application shall send and receive data from field device I/O cards through I/O driver software.
The RLCS application shall require a user name and password for GUI access.
The RLCS application shall display current date, time, user name, and workstation location on the GUI.
The RLCS application shall display facility status, traffic flow direction, and device sensor status on the GUI.
The RLCS application shall issue an audible alarm and visual indicator when an alarm condition occurs.
The RLCS application shall store and export system activity logs including device commands, alarms, and operator diaries.
The RLCS application shall monitor all field device sensors and process status change requests.
The RLCS application shall validate all control commands against security rules before execution.
The RLCS application shall execute stored operational control command sequences based on the current system mode and schedule.
The RLCS application shall halt opening or closing sequences if a device fails to report completion or if an illegal state is detected.
The RLCS application shall use a one-way hash function (MD5) to verify the integrity of application data and software.
The RLCS application shall be available 24 hours per day, 7 days per week, 365 days per year.
The RLCS application shall update the external server data store at least once per minute.
The RLCS application shall update field device status information on the GUI within 2 seconds of occurrence.
The RLCS application shall detect alarm conditions within 2 seconds of occurrence.
The RLCS application shall function continuously without rebooting for at least 30 consecutive days.
The RLCS application shall maintain at least 99.99% yearly uptime.
The RLCS application shall allow for future roadway changes without requiring programming effort by using non-volatile memory-based tables.
